name: supplier-risk-signal-watch
title: Supplier Risk Signal Watch
description: Composite supplier-distress monitoring: sanctions hits, court filings, recall events and financial signals scored per supplier into a single risk signal for procurement resilience teams.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Supplier Risk Signal Watch
input.description: Composite supplier-distress monitoring: sanctions hits, court filings, recall events and financial signals scored per supplier into a single risk signal for procurement resilience teams.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

signal_sources.title: Signal sources
signal_sources.description: Signal categories to include (sanctions, court, recall, financial).

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
